title: Search halted for teen swept away by big waves in Surigao del Sur

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur— Search and retrieval operations for a 14-year-old boy who was swept away by strong waves off Barangay Victoria in Tago, Surigao del Sur were suspended on Tuesday after rough sea conditions posed severe risks to emergency personnel. In Notice to Mariners No. CGSSDS-1126-002, the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) Station Surigao del Sur identified the missing teenager as Jaymark C. Rivas, a resident of Purok Macopa in Barangay Victoria. According to the PCG advisory issued by station commander Ens. Mark Rudolf Garcia, Rivas was swimming along the shoreline when strong waves pulled him away, an incident aggravated […]...
